'''Dodson Makraven''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]] who attained many [[Death/Legends|kills]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]], and would later join the Imperial [[Obsidian Squadron/Legends|Obsidian Squadron]] flying as the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] of the squadron's lead [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Civé Rashon/Legends|Civé Rashon]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Makraven attempted to destroy an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that had fled to an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] after being disabled in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], although Makraven's attempt failed, with the Alliance starship being repaired and escaping the Imperial ambush.

==Biography==
[[File:FFG_Night_Beast.png|thumb|left|300px|Makraven flying as Obsidian 2]]
Dodson Makraven was a [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. At some point during the conflict, Makraven had attained many [[Death/Legends|kills]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]]. He would also earn the nickname of "Night Beast" for many curfew violations. Makraven joined the Imperial [[Obsidian Squadron/Legends|Obsidian Squadron]], flying under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[Obsidian 2]], with the further designation of OS-72-2. In his Obsidian Squadron service, Makraven flew as the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] of [[Civé Rashon/Legends|Civé Rashon]],<ref name="CCG" /> the squadron's lead [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], who flew under the call sign of [[Obsidian 1]].<ref name="CCG1">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=OS-72-1 In Obsidian 1}}</ref> At some point after he obtained the nickname of "Night Beast," Makraven and at least one other [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] pilot attacked an Alliance [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that had fled into an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] after being disabled by an Imperial outpost in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], with [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] flying a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] in defense of the ship.<ref name="Asteroid Run">{{StoryCite|story=Mission 2: Asteroid Run|book=Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game Core Set|bformatted=''Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game'' Core Set}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|option=1|Mission 2: Asteroid Run}}
Ultimately, the Alliance starship was repaired and managed to flee from the TIE pilots.<ref name="Asteroid Run" />
{{Endgame}}

At another point during the Galactic Civil War, Makraven flew his [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/LN]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] through [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]<ref name="FFG">{{FFGXW|set=Core Set|cardname="Night Beast"}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Makraven wore the standard [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] for TIE pilots.<ref name="CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DS-61-4.jpg|thumb|right|200px|DS-61-4, whose image was reused to represent Makraven]]
Dodson Makraven was created for a card in the [[1998]] ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. Of note, the image used for Makraven's card<ref name="CCG" /> is of a TIE pilot who appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> who was previously identified as [[DS-61-4]] in [[1996]], for Decipher's ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' expansion set of the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game.<ref name="DS614card">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=DS-61-4}}</ref> In [[2012]], he was also included in ''[[Mission 2: Asteroid Run]]'', a starfighter combat scenario written for the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game]]'' and published as a rules supplement in the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game Core Set]]''. In that scenario, Makraven is described as flying alongside [[Mithel/Legends|Mithel]],<ref name="Asteroid Run" /> a TIE pilot whose death in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] is clearly depicted in ''A New Hope''.<ref name="ANH" /> As the scenario described in ''Mission 2: Asteroid Run'' is clearly chronologically after the events of ''A New Hope'', given Luke Skywalker's involvement<ref name="Asteroid Run" />&mdash;while ''A New Hope'' shows the Battle of Yavin was Skywalker's first time in starfighter combat<ref name="ANH" />&mdash;this article treats a second TIE pilot participating with Makraven in the attack on the Alliance starship as [[canon]], without mentioning the identity of the individual.

''Mission 2: Asteroid Run'' has more than one possible ending as well. Other possible outcomes involve the TIE pilots destroying the Alliance starship, or the starship being destroyed if it flees while its [[Communications relay/Legends|communications relay]] and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] have not yet been fully repaired. Alternatively, the Alliance ship will also be destroyed if it flees off of a non-Imperial or Alliance edge of the play area. This article assumes the outcome depicted in the in-universe portion, where the Alliance starship manages to successfully flee from the TIE pilots after undergoing repairs.<ref name="Asteroid Run" />
